title: Himalayan Wilds
game_overview: Explore the Himalayan wilderness, track game, gather materials, and recruit specialists to transform a struggling mountain settlement into a thriving village.
winning_condition: Restore the mountain pass, recruit all specialists, and construct a thriving Himalayan settlement across all 8 story chapters.
losing_condition: Player health is completely depleted from predatory wildlife attacks or steep mountain falls.

controls.input: W / A / S / D or Arrow Keys
controls.action: First-person walk and strafe locomotion through mountain sectors.

Shoot bow, swing harvest tool, or place building preview.
Draw bow and zoom view for precision animal tracking and hunting.
Interact with NPCs, harvest felled deer, gather herbs/wood, and open chests.

View quest objectives, discovered animal tracks, and settlement progress.
Toggle regional exploration map and landmark markers.

Leap over boulders, fallen logs, and river shallows.
Sprint across open valleys and mountain trails.

sections.title: Design Pillars
sections.content: 1. Grounded Preindustrial Atmosphere: Timber, slate, stone, woven fiber, and natural wilderness without fantasy magic or modern firearms. 2. Non-Metered Exploration: Deep gathering, hunting, crafting, and building mechanics without tedious hunger, thirst, or stamina meters. 3. Tangible Settlement Evolution: Every recruited NPC and constructed workshop visually transforms the village and unlocks real mechanical crafting and building capabilities.
sections.summary: Core creative principles of preindustrial Himalayan survival and village expansion.

sections.title: Core Loop
sections.content: Explore Himalayan biomes (lower forest, river valley, upper conifers, alpine passes, abandoned ruins) -> Track and hunt deer, goral, and boar for pelts, hides, and bones -> Gather wood, river stone, fibers, and medicinal herbs with unlimited inventory stacks -> Return to the settlement to recruit specialists, craft advanced non-metal gear, and construct functional workshops -> Advance the 8-chapter main storyline to restore the mountain trail and build a thriving Himalayan village.
sections.summary: Moment-to-moment gameplay loop from wilderness exploration to settlement building.

sections.title: Core Mechanics
sections.content: 1. Wildlife AI & Dynamic Tracking: Deer and wildlife feature grazing, alert, fleeing, and drinking behaviors. Discoverable animal tracks and clues provide contextual hints for tracking herds. 2. Ranged Bow Hunting & Harvesting: Ballistic arrow physics, draw tension, and non-food harvesting (hides, sinew, bone, antlers). 3. Unlimited-Stack Inventory & Crafting: Frictionless resource management with tiered recipes unlocked through specialist recruits. 4. Grid & Freeform Settlement Construction: Place houses, workshops, storages, watchtowers, and bridges with collision and upgrade paths.
sections.summary: Hunting, tracking, gathering, crafting, and modular construction systems.

sections.title: 3D Camera & Movement Alignment
sections.content: Camera Perspective: First-person camera with smooth mouse-look and touch yaw/pitch control (FOV 75, height 1.6m). 3D Coordinate Convention: Standard Three.js right-handed coordinates (-Z is forward, +Y is up, +X is right). Movement Dynamics: Rapier character controller with slope navigation, step height, jump impulse, and smooth ground detection. Visual Alignment: First-person held bow/tools and all world assets face -Z standard forward.
sections.summary: First-person perspective with physics-driven spatial locomotion.

sections.title: 3D Scene & Environment Structure
sections.content: Environment: Rich terrain topography featuring rocky outcrops, pine and oak forests, rushing mountain river, abandoned stone settlements, and snow-dusted alpine ridges. Atmospheric Lighting: Dynamic sun arc with mountain haze, physically accurate ambient lighting (ambientIntensity >= 1.5, sunIntensity >= 3.0), and warm village hearthfires. Visual Separation: Distinctive timber and slate architecture clearly contrasts with wild pine vegetation and granite cliffs.
sections.summary: Connected Himalayan valleys with procedural terrain, dense foliage, and dynamic atmosphere.

sections.title: Characters & Enemies
sections.content: NPC Specialists: Hunter (unlocks tracking & bows), Carpenter (unlocks timber houses & storage), Herbalist (unlocks medicinal recipes), Builder (unlocks stone structures & bridges), and Trader (resource exchanges). Wildlife: Himalayan Deer (grazing herds), Wild Boar (foraging), Mountain Goral (rocky crags), and rare Snow Leopards patrolling upper ridges.
sections.summary: Wildlife ecosystem and specialist settlement inhabitants.

sections.title: Fairness Tools
sections.content: Compass HUD with quest objective markers, animal tracking scent trails, building placement validation bounding boxes with green/red indicator guides, and interactive map with discovered landmarks.
sections.summary: Assistance systems for wilderness navigation and construction.

sections.title: Juice & Game Feel
sections.content: Anticipation Juice: Bow draw camera zoom, audio tension creak, and aim reticle focus. State Change Juice: Discovery fanfare when entering new regions or unlocking settlement tiers, plus day/night atmospheric transitions. Impact Juice: Arrow impact thuds, wood chopping particle bursts, and satisfying stone/timber settling audio upon building completion.
sections.summary: Tactile feedback for archery, gathering, and building.

sections.title: Social Mechanics & Audience
sections.content: Designed for players who love deep open-world wilderness survival, atmospheric exploration, archery hunting, and settlement simulation games. Features persistent settlement milestones and discovery stats.
sections.summary: Target audience and singleplayer immersion features.

sections.title: Accessibility
sections.content: Customizable mouse/touch look sensitivity, crosshair style options, high-contrast objective icons, scalable UI font sizes, and full keyboard/touch remapping.

sections.title: Structural Integrity
sections.content: Main Menu -> Intro Narrative -> 8-Chapter Story Campaign with persistent settlement state -> Free Exploration End-Game. LocalStorage persistence for inventory, buildings, recruited NPCs, and quest completions.

sections.title: Virtual Touch Controls Implementation
sections.content: Conditionally rendered on mobile devices: Left Virtual Joystick for walking, right-hand Look Drag area, and dedicated action buttons for Jump, Interact, Attack/Shoot, Aim, Build, and Inventory. Configured with touch-none and pointer-events-auto on buttons.
